name: expansion-recoding kernel lift
axis: high-dim sparse map BEFORE store (upstream of abstain margin)
knob: frozen random sparse expansion E R^d->R^{kd} fan-in 4-5 + top-k sparsify before L2 affinity
frozen_bar: recall_expand - recall_baseline >= +0.05 on >=2/3 seeds on confusable subset (MARGIN=0.05)
ablation: rank-collapse E->identity-rank d-projection same params reverts; SHUFFLE rows collapses
source: Marr 1969 / Albus 1971; Litwin-Kumar et al 2017; Babadi & Sompolinsky 2014; Xie et al 2023 eLife

name: cascade metaplasticity store
axis: per-cell consolidation state (orthogonal to recall margin)
capability: early-fact retention after K interfering facts (interference/retention curve)
knob: per-cell 2-3 level Benna-Fusi cascade variable; consolidation depth = confirmation count
frozen_bar: retention_cascade - retention_flat >= +0.05 at interference horizon, >=2/3 seeds
ablation: freeze cascade depth=0 -> flat single-timescale store; SHUFFLE which fact consolidates collapses

name: multi-store encode/retrieve-split CLS
axis: WHERE/HOW a fact is held (2 stores, phase-separated writes)
capability: AB-AC interference (A->B retention after learning A->C)
knob: fast episodic store written in encode-phase (retrieval path suppressed, Hasselmo) + slow store via replay
ablation: merge stores / disable phase-separation reverts to 1-store; SHUFFLE store-assignment collapses
hazard: implement as multi-STORE/phase-separated writes NOT scalar gain (gain framing re-enters controller family wall absorbs, H_1422 ACh lens)

name: curiosity-gated acquisition
axis: WHAT gets stored (input selection at acquisition time)
capability: recall under fixed store budget N<all facts
knob: admit fact iff key-novelty / expected info-gain > adaptive threshold (skip redundant collinear dups)
frozen_bar: recall_curiosity - recall_random-admission >= +0.05 at budget N, >=2/3 seeds
ablation: random admission @ same budget reverts; SHUFFLE info-gain scores collapses
source: Gottlieb & Oudeyer 2018 Nat Rev Neurosci; Gottlieb 2023
scope: lower a-priori: helps under CAPACITY budget, less when store holds everything
